name: Lovense
description: A reusable library for Lovense discovery, command construction, replies, and paced communication.
capabilities: Device type, firmware, battery, and capabilities.
Vibrate and LVS commands on the tested Max.
Choose the device’s TX and RX characteristics.
Documented commands are not all supported by every model.
tested: Checked against a live Lovense Max on firmware 223, using bleak on macOS.
limits: The tested Max returns an unknown-command reply for Mply and binary 0xAA frames. The library is not integrated into a hub.
code:
from openble.lovense import commands

command = commands.vibrate(10)
print(command)  # b'Vibrate:10;'
